csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using System.Reflection; public class FixPlayerReferences { public static string Execute() { GameObject player = GameObject.Find("Player_Test01"); if (player == null) return "Player_Test01 not found."; var presenter = player.GetComponent<PlayerPresenter>(); var rb = player.GetComponent<Rigidbody>(); if (presenter == null || rb == null) return "Presenter or Rigidbody missing."; FieldInfo rbField = presenter.GetType().GetField("_rigidbody3D", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance); if (rbField == null) return "_rigidbody3D field not found."; rbField.SetValue(presenter, rb); return $"Successfully assigned Rigidbody to PlayerPresenter on {player.name}."; } }
